request.subject: UNIT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Make him a plain, lightly equipped basic foot soldier: the big pointed heraldic shield becomes a small plain round wooden shield, half as wide, of pale brown planks with a thin steel rim and a round steel boss, no lion and no paint; no chainmail, only a simple crimson cloth tunic with the gold cross, cream linen sleeves and a brown belt. Keep the helmet with its crimson crest, the face, sword, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
